productGoal: Suno-like experience, but ONLY optimization (no from-scratch generation), built on the Korg Pa800 foundation: user brings a file, the system understands it, proposes evidence-backed optimizations, user confirms, and receives a Pa800-importable result (.sty/SMF) plus a gated report.

sunoMapping.sunoStyleModel: role/pattern evidence + Pa800 layout (markers, CV, sections)
sunoMapping.sunoMakeSong: optimization plan: per-action status DOKAZANO / ZAHTEVA_ODLUKU / ZAKLJUCANO
sunoMapping.sunoAudioOut: Pa800 .sty export (SMF0 + markers) + optimized SMF + gate report

phases.A: consolidated single-pass report over all engines (CLI) - ~90% exists
phases.B: Node stdlib bridge (node:http + child_process python, no npm deps)
phases.C: React flow: upload -> analysis -> plan -> apply confirmed actions -> export
phases.D: WebAudio A/B audition in browser (own small synth, no external deps)

feasibilityChecked.reactApp: src/main.jsx 415 lines + musicAnalysis.js 483 lines (exists, npm test 7/7)

invariants: original file never overwritten (outputs to artifacts-*)
velocity authority FACTORY_ONLY; no bank/program without evidence
DNC/slap/pop triggers locked until device capture (warrant ledger)
every applied action carries reason + gate; reports are the proof
no network/no extra installs at runtime (stdlib + built-in JS)
round2Conclusion: GitHub nema projekat koji je 'Suno za Pa800 optimizaciju'. Najblize: KORG-Tools (GPL, C++, format dok. + parser/writer Pa SET/style), ostinato (MIT, live arranger — vec nasa import-side referenca), sonotron (GPL, C++). Sve GPL -> studija; SMF0+markeri putanja ostaje nasa jedina izvozna (bez kontaminacije).
